description: Gender pay gap per category of workers from aggregated figures: number of women and men and mean (optionally median) pay per category. Categories where a sex has fewer workers than the minimum cell (at least 5) show no figures, and further categories are hidden when needed so that no hidden figure can be worked back from the overall gap. Flags gaps at or above the jurisdiction's joint-pay-assessment threshold. Not for: employee-level rows, names or IDs, or official national pay gap statistics; reporting duties by company size are in gap_reporting_rules.

categories.description: One entry per category of workers (same work or work of equal value, for example a job grade or role group): number of women and men and mean (average), optionally median, pay of each. Aggregated figures only, never one row per employee.

men.description: Aggregated figures for the men in the category.

count.description: Number of men in the category (a whole number, 0 or more).

mean.description: Mean (average) pay of the men in the category.

median.description: Median pay of the men in the category (optional).

women.description: Aggregated figures for the women in the category.

count.description: Number of women in the category (a whole number, 0 or more).

mean.description: Mean (average) pay of the women in the category.

median.description: Median pay of the women in the category (optional).

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

measure.description: hourly (hourly pay) or annual (annual salary) figures.

name: pay_gap_from_aggregates
title: Pay gap from aggregates
